source_refs.verified_excerpt: Open Settings. Tap General, tap Date & Time, then turn on Set Time Automatically.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Make sure that your device is connected to the internet. 2. Install the latest software updates for your device. 3. Open Settings. If the device has a Screen Time passcode or a corporate profile with device restrictions installed, the setting might be dimmed (grayed out).
